value.rationale: The dyadic trichotomy for a canonical one-hub network quantitatively characterizes how a universal vertex changes nilpotent mixing and exact times of entry into recurrent dynamics. It settles every first-entry shell on infinitely many labelled wheel graphs, with probability universality across all odd circumference multipliers. The exceptional length-three behavior at the first two valuations is structural rather than a routine single determinant calculation.
